title: VersionWarning
description: This is a Minecraft plugin for Spigot/Paper which allows server administrators to warn players when they join with deprecated or soon unsupported client versions.
body:
This is a Minecraft plugin for Spigot/Paper which allows server administrators to warn players when they join with deprecated or soon unsupported client versions.

**New in Version 1.0.0:**
- Join warnings for deprecated Minecraft client versions
- Fully configurable warning rules in `config.yml`
- Supports protocol-based matching for old and newer versions
- Custom warning messages with placeholders and color codes
- Optional admin notifications when deprecated clients join
- Console logging for detected deprecated client versions
- Self-toggle for players with permission using `/vw toggle`
- Reload command for config changes without restarting the server
- Debug mode for troubleshooting protocol detection
- Supports Minecraft versions from 1.17 up to 26.2

**Commands:**
- /versionwarning reload - Reload the plugin configuration
- /versionwarning check <player> - Check a player's detected client version
- /versionwarning list - Show all configured deprecation rules
- /versionwarning toggle - Toggle your own warnings on or off

**Permissions:**
- versionwarning.admin - Access to admin commands
- versionwarning.bypass - Allows toggling your own warnings with /vw toggle
- versionwarning.notify - Receive admin notifications for deprecated joins

**Important when updating:**
If you update from an older build, replace the old jar and review your `config.yml` settings. If needed, delete the existing config to regenerate the latest default values.

Just send me a message on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/vVrpvBEfeQ) if you have any questions, suggestions, or requests for new plugins.
